cardOverview.overviewText: A Digismart card from Standard Chartered offering discounts on shopping, dining, and travel with a unique monthly subscription-based model, ideal for cost-conscious digital users.

benefitRows.name: Blinkit
benefitRows.offer: Key in the promo code DIGISMART and get 10% off on Blinkit with no minimum spend.|This offer is valid for five transactions per month, with a monthly discount maximum of INR 1,000
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, order groceries or essentials on the Blinkit app. Apply promo code DIGISMART during checkout using your Standard Chartered DigiSmart credit card. Offer valid for five transactions per month, with a monthly discount cap of ₹1,000. Contact Standard Chartered customer care at 1860 267 0000 for help.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Buy one get one on movie ticket bookings at INOX, subject to a maximum discount of Rs 200 per transaction.|The offer is applicable on Saturdays and Sundays only.|The offer can be used for a maximum of 2 transactions per month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
